body: Code changes: +278 -7\ Tests: +309 -3\ Others: +0 -0 ## What The mobile New task page now lists the agent's skills when you type `/` at the start of the prompt, as the chat composer and the desktop's new chat page (#9095) do. ## Why The New task composer had no `/` menu, so a task that starts with a skill had to be typed out by name. #9095 added `GET /api/v1/agents/{agent}/skills` so a page can list skills before any session runs; this uses it on mobile. ## Before / After Same machine, project (with one project skill) and agent; `/` typed in the New task prompt. | Before | After | | --- | --- | | | | | | | | The chat composer's `/` list (reference, unchanged) | The New task list matches it: same entries and order, panel, margin and gap | | | | ## How - **Data:** `getAgentSkills` calls the new route for the picked machine, agent and project (none for a standalone agent). As on desktop, the list a chat of that agent last reported comes first, so built-ins like `/advisor` and `/compact` show and the order matches the chat's, and skills only found on disk follow (`mergeChatSkills`). Reported lists are kept in memory per machine, agent and project (`lib/chat/rememberedSkills.ts`, filled by `ChatSessionScreen`), and dropped when a machine is forgotten, like the remembered model catalogs. A project chat's list is kept for that project only; another project falls back to a list from a chat with no project, so one project's own skills never show in another's. A chat that switches agents clears its skills, as it clears its models, and a chat's skills are only ever shown for the agent that reported them. Scans are cached for 30 s. Cloud tasks get no list. A machine on a version without the route answers 404, which lists none; 4xx are P3 and never reach Sentry. - **Composer:** `SpawnComposer` reuses the chat's `findComposerSuggestion` / `rankComposerSkills` / `replaceComposerSuggestion` and `ComposerSuggestionPanel`. Only `/`: an `@` file needs a worktree the task has not made yet. - **Overlay:** the panel is drawn by the page (via `SpawnSuggestionHost`) over the room and dock, ending above the composer and riding the dock's keyboard transform, instead of in the dock's column. The machine and project rows stay put, and the list stays inside its parent's bounds so Android delivers its taps and scrolls. A page-coloured backing under the panel stands in for the chat dock's fade, so rows don't show through the glass. The dock now uses the chat's side margin (`space.sm`). Intentional omissions: - Remembered chat lists live in memory, like the model catalogs, not on disk as on desktop: after an app restart, New task lists the scanned skills until a chat's `/` list is opened again. - Built-ins (`/compact`) appear only once a chat of that agent has reported them, since no folder holds them (same as desktop). ## Testing - `packages/mobile` on Node 20 as in CI: `npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` (505 files, 5253 tests) pass. After the review fixes (647bd68994, 3b55164c15, 55f3e5904f), typecheck and `npm test` (5258 tests) pass on Node 24. - New tests: `spawn-composer.test.tsx` (`/` lists, filters, inserts, hands the panel to the page's host, and settles when the page stores the panel and passes a new `onChangePrompt` each render), `spawnSkills.test.ts` (route, 404, cache, merge, offline fallback), `rememberedSkills.test.ts`, and the agent-switch cases in `useConversation.turnOptions.test.tsx`. - Device: iOS 26.5 simulator and an Android 15 emulator, Release apps with main and branch JS bundles swapped in, paired to a scratch daemon built from this branch with a throwaway project. Checked `/` opens over the page without moving the rows, scrolls, filters (`/ship` → the project skill), and a pick inserts `/skill-name ` on both. ## Checklist - [x] Branched from `main` (or continuing an existing PR branch) - [x] One focused change; links the related issue when applicable - [x] Follows [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator/blob/main/AGENTS.md) conventions and PR hygiene - [x] Before / After filled in; UI changes include screenshots or a recording - [x] Tests added/updated for user-visible behavior where it makes sense - [ ] Relevant CI checks pass for the area touched (`go`, frontend, etc.) ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added searchable slash-command skill suggestions to the mobile prompt composer. Select a result to insert it into the prompt. * Skills load for the selected agent and project when the composer is focused. Chat-reported skills appear alongside machine-discovered skills, and remembered skills remain available when the machine is offline. * Suggestions appear above the composer, move with the keyboard, and close when the prompt no longer matches a supported skill command.
title: feat(mobile): list skills in the New task page's / menu
